title: looks_like_bcrypt_hash promotion to public API: correct placement and scope
description: looks_like_bcrypt_hash is pub in stoa_auth and used directly by reader, smtp, and imap validate() instead of being re-pub-used through each crate. This is the right design: the validation function belongs in the auth crate (single source of truth), each caller imports it directly, and reader::config changed pub use to use to avoid leaking it as part of reader's API surface. A contributor might suggest moving the function into each crate's own validate() — that would be wrong because it creates three separate definitions that can drift.
